descriptions.preferred: Each small leaf is fivelobed, with the center lobe noticeably longer. The lobes are ovate-lanceolate and deeply divided. The sharp lobe tips tend to turn downward. The margins are toothed. The leafstalks are a rich green tinged with pink. Early spring leaves are beautiful. The edges are tinged with orange-red, which is lightly and delicately shaded into the light green leaf center. The summer foliage is a rich green, turning yellow-orange in the fall. 'Kiyohime' is a sturdy, vigorous plant, suitable for container and bonsai culture. It can form a dense roundish bush 61⁄2 ft. (2 m) high. The name means "yellow-leaved dwarf. "

sources.name: Acer palmatum 'Kiyohime'
sources.description: 'Kiyohime' Japanese maple is a dwarf, spreading maple cultivar in the maple family (Sapindaceae). It is known for its interesting leaf coloring. Japanese maples are native to southeast Korea and central and south Japan. Acer is Latin for sharp and palmatum means shaped like a hand, referring to the leaves. It will reach only 2 to 3 feet in height but grows twice as wide. It prefers humus-rich, well-drained soil, moderate water and full to partial sun. It is very tolerant of hot summers. In the early spring, its leaves have a distinctive red-purple border. The leaves are green in summer and then change to yellows and red or orange in fall. Plant it in small spaces, a container, or in Asian gardens. It is often used in bonsai. Insects, Diseases, and Other Plant Problems: Aphids, scale, maple worms, leafrollers, and leafhoppers are occasional pests. Anthracnose, leaf scorch, and frost damage, especially from late frosts, can occur. It self-seeds easily so can spread and become weedy in the landscape. See potential insect and disease problem fact sheets to the left. The Clemson Cooperative Extension Home and Garden Information Center has a factsheet on common maple diseases and insect pests.

rhs.description: A vigorous, dense, dwarf shrub reaching 2m in height and spread, with small, five lobed leaves that open in spring a pale green tinted orange-red at the edges, maturing to rich green in summer, then yellow-orange in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Wildlife Gardens
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Acer leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。
attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、野生动物友好型花园

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，位置以避风庇护处为佳。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤能持续保持湿润，也可耐全日照。槭树叶焦常因土壤缺水或暴露过度所致。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 生长势较强、株丛紧密的矮生灌木，高度和冠幅均可达 2 米。 叶片较小，5 裂，春季萌发时为浅绿色，叶缘带橙红色晕染；夏季成熟为浓绿色，秋季转为黄橙色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 每片小叶为五裂，中裂片明显较长。 裂片呈卵状披针形，分裂较深。 尖锐的裂片先端常向下弯。 叶缘具锯齿。 叶柄浓绿色并带粉色。 早春新叶十分美观，叶缘染有橙红色，并轻柔地渐晕入浅绿色的叶片中央。 夏季叶色浓绿，秋季转为黄橙色。 'Kiyohime' 是一个结实而长势旺盛的品种，适合容器栽培和盆景栽培。 可形成高约 2 米、近圆形且致密的灌丛。 其名称意为“黄叶矮生”。
